content.rendered:
We have a rule here on the Shuffle: If you’re going to cover a Bruce Springsteen song, either do it different or do it better.

Every once in a while, though, it’s worth making an exception for someone who simply and powerfully connects with the song.

Lucas Mège is one such artist.

Lucas’ YouTube page features several great Springsteen covers, but his solo piano arrangement of “Drive All Night” is a cut above. Beautifully shot, impeccably recorded, and passionately performed, Lucas’ version is every bit as sincere, powerful, and gorgeous as Bruce’s original.

Take a few minutes out of your day to listen–you won’t be disappointed.

© March 29, 2021

excerpt.rendered: Springsteen fan Lucas Mège shares his gorgeous, passionate, and powerful solo piano performance of “Drive All NIght.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Elysium: Drive All Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Irish cover band Elysium breathes new life into "Drive All Night" with their achingly beautiful mash-up.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Sharon Van Etten (and TomBerry26): Drive All Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Stop what you're doing and listen to this gorgeous, haunting rendition of "Drive All Night" by Sharon Van Etten, enhanced by "TomBerry26."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Drive All Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: You can find the heart of many Springsteen songs in a single line. In "Drive All Night," it's in the sax solo--it says more than any lyric ever could.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Jason Flynn: Drive All Night
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Every once in a while, a beautiful Springsteen cover comes out of nowhere. Here's one, from a busker on the streets of Dublin.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Melissa Etheridge: Thunder Road
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Straight from her daily stay-at-home Facebook Live concerts, here's Melissa Etheridge's gorgeous rendition of "Thunder Road."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Trace Jory: Stolen Car
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Trace Jory was introduced to "Stolen Car" through X Ambassador's creative cover, but he drew on Bruce's original arrangement for his own rendition.
